    private $stripeApiKey;
    private $awsAccessKey;
    private $awsSecretKey;

        // Load environment variables from .env file (not committed to git)
        if (file_exists(__DIR__ . '/.env')) {
            $dotenv = Dotenv::createImmutable(__DIR__);
            $dotenv->load();
            
            // Validate required variables exist
            $dotenv->required(['STRIPE_API_KEY', 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY', 'AWS_SECRET_KEY']);
        }
        
        // Load from environment (works in both dev and production)
        $this->stripeApiKey = getenv('STRIPE_API_KEY');
        $this->awsAccessKey = getenv('AWS_ACCESS_KEY');
        $this->awsSecretKey = getenv('AWS_SECRET_KEY');
        
        // Validate keys are present
        if (empty($this->stripeApiKey)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('STRIPE_API_KEY environment variable not set');
        }
    }
    
    public function chargeCustomer(string $customerId, int $amount): array {
        \Stripe\Stripe::setApiKey($this->stripeApiKey);
        
        try {
            $charge = \Stripe\Charge::create([
                'customer' => $customerId,
                'amount' => $amount,
                'currency' => 'usd'
            ]);
            
            // SECURE: Log transaction without exposing keys
            $this->logTransaction($customerId, $amount, $charge->id);

            // SECURE: Log error without exposing sensitive data
            error_log("Payment failed for customer: " . $this->maskId($customerId));

        }

        // Only show last 4 characters for debugging

        // Secure logging without sensitive data
        error_log(sprintf(
            "Transaction: customer=%s amount=%d charge=%s",
            $this->maskId($customerId),
            $amount,

class SecureNetworkDiagnostics
{
    private const ALLOWED_COMMANDS = ['nslookup', 'dig', 'host'];
    private const MAX_DOMAIN_LENGTH = 253;

    public function nslookup(string $domain): array
    {
        // DEFENSE 1: Strict domain validation using filter_var
        $domain = $this->validateDomain($domain);
        if ($domain === false) {
            $this->logSecurityEvent('invalid_domain_attempt', $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'unknown');
            return ['error' => 'Invalid domain format', 'success' => false];
        }
        
        // DEFENSE 2: Use PHP's built-in DNS functions instead of shell commands
        $result = $this->performDnsLookup($domain);
        
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function validateDomain(string $input): string|false
    {
        // Trim and lowercase
        $domain = strtolower(trim($input));
        
        // Length check
        if (strlen($domain) > self::MAX_DOMAIN_LENGTH || strlen($domain) < 1) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // DEFENSE 3: Use FILTER_VALIDATE_DOMAIN (PHP 7+)
        if (filter_var($domain, FILTER_VALIDATE_DOMAIN, FILTER_FLAG_HOSTNAME) === false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // DEFENSE 4: Additional strict validation - no shell metacharacters possible
        if (!preg_match('/^(?!-)[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-)(\.(?!-)[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-))*$/', $domain)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // DEFENSE 5: Block known malicious patterns
        $blockedPatterns = ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', 'internal', '.local'];
        foreach ($blockedPatterns as $pattern) {
            if (stripos($domain, $pattern) !== false) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        return $domain;
    }
    
    private function performDnsLookup(string $domain): array
    {

class SecureImageProcessor {
    private $uploadDir = '/var/www/uploads/';
    private $allowedMimeTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'];
    private $maxFileSize = 5242880; // 5MB
    
    public function __construct() {
        // Disable dangerous ImageMagick coders via policy.xml
        // This should also be done at system level
        putenv('MAGICK_CONFIGURE_PATH=/etc/ImageMagick-6/');
    }
    
    public function processUpload($file) {
        // Validate file upload
        if ($file['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new Exception('Upload failed');
        }
        
        if ($file['size'] > $this->maxFileSize) {
            throw new Exception('File too large');
        }
        
        // Verify MIME type using actual file content, not extension
        $finfo = new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mimeType = $finfo->file($file['tmp_name']);
        
        if (!in_array($mimeType, $this->allowedMimeTypes, true)) {
            error_log("Rejected file upload with MIME type: {$mimeType}");
            throw new Exception('Invalid file type. Only JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP allowed.');
        }
        
        // Generate safe filename (no user input)
        $safeFilename = bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.' . $this->getExtension($mimeType);
        $destPath = $this->uploadDir . $safeFilename;
        
        // Move to destination
        if (!move_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'], $destPath)) {
            throw new Exception('Failed to save file');
        }
        
        // Process with GD library (safer than ImageMagick for untrusted files)
        $thumbnail = $this->createThumbnailWithGD($destPath, $mimeType);
        
        return [
            'status' => 'success',
            'filename' => $safeFilename,
            'thumbnail' => $thumbnail
        ];
    }
    
    private function createThumbnailWithGD($path, $mimeType) {
        // GD doesn't process URLs or external entities
        $image = match($mimeType) {
            'image/jpeg' => imagecreatefromjpeg($path),
            'image/png' => imagecreatefrompng($path),
            'image/gif' => imagecreatefromgif($path),
            'image/webp' => imagecreatefromwebp($path),
            default => throw new Exception('Unsupported format')
        };
        
        $width = imagesx($image);
        $height = imagesy($image);
        $thumbWidth = 200;
        $thumbHeight = (int)($height * ($thumbWidth / $width));
        
        $thumbnail = imagecreatetruecolor($thumbWidth, $thumbHeight);
        imagecopyresampled($thumbnail, $image, 0, 0, 0, 0, 
                          $thumbWidth, $thumbHeight, $width, $height);
        
        $thumbPath = str_replace('.', '_thumb.', $path);
        imagejpeg($thumbnail, $thumbPath, 85);
        
        imagedestroy($image);
        imagedestroy($thumbnail);
        
        return basename($thumbPath);
    }
    
    private function getExtension($mimeType) {
        return match($mimeType) {
            'image/jpeg' => 'jpg',
            'image/png' => 'png',
            'image/gif' => 'gif',
            'image/webp' => 'webp',
            default => 'bin'
        };
    }
